text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Nic Cruz Patane shared Tesla FSD v15's Reality View in a busy downtown setting. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6679)

2 — Tesla shared a demonstration it described as FSD v15 navigating around a large branch blocking the road. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6680)

3 — OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki published pretraining measurements and proposed shared AI development limits based on perplexity and other metrics, with further progress gated on improved understanding and monitoring of AI behavior. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6681)

4 — Max Zeff reported that Dario Amodei, while at OpenAI, suggested immersive video games might address political strife caused by AI-induced unemployment. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6682)

5 — The channel author shared Gemini-generated comics based on their reinforcement-learning video, noting that comics help convey the big picture but cannot capture much detail. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6683)

6 — CodeByNZ relayed an explicitly unconfirmed, thinly sourced claim that a model called Claude Saga 6 leads a leaderboard with 2,294 points, ahead of Fable 5.2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6686)

--Hermes.
